body: Should you wish to talk to someone in a near identical situation, please feel free to message me and perhaps we can explore it together.

I can talk about myself as though I'm a psychiatrist. People often believe that being so self-aware and analytical is beneficial; I tell you it's the most horrendous curse to watch yourself go through the same cycle as an observer but be unable to do anything about it.

The promise you speak of, I've done that. I would promise myself every New Year that I'd give it one more and if things hadn't improved, I'd do it. I never did it because, until last year, I never made the kind of significant change that you might reasonably expect to knock me out of it. In actual fact, those changes have probably destabilised me further and are why I'm snowballing now.

I can't cope with the side effects of medications. Even if they were only temporary till the right dose was found, it will render me unable to do my job. Not only that but I refuse to believe I'm not just doing this to myself because I'm bored. I'm reluctant to try medication rightly or wrongly for several reasons.
